blocks.text: Carbohydrates naturally occurring (qudrati tor par milne wale) organic compounds hain. In mein sugars (shakar), starch (nishasta), cellulose, aur bacteria ki cell walls aur insects (keeron) ke bahar wale sakht khol (exoskeleton) ke maadde shamil hain. Yeh hamari diet (khurak) mein energy ka bara source (zariya) hain. Kitab kehti hai ke tamam carbohydrates 'carbon ke hydrates' hain. Chemistry ki zabaan mein yeh polyhydroxy aldehydes ya ketones hain (yani aise aldehydes ya ketones jin mein bohat se –OH groups hon), ya un se bane compounds.
1. Monosaccharides

Monosaccharides sab se saada carbohydrates hain jinhein aam taur par sugars kehte hain, maslan glucose aur fructose. Inhein hydrolysis (paani ke saath reaction se torna) kar ke mazeed saada compounds mein nahi toda ja sakta. In ka general formula Cₙ(H₂O)y hai, jahan n teen se saat tak hota hai. Teen carbon wala monosaccharide triose, chaar wala tetrose, paanch wala pentose aur chhe wala hexose kehlata hai. Functional group ke lihaz se bhi inhein do qismon mein baanta jata hai: ketose (jis mein ketone group ho) aur aldose (jis mein aldehyde group ho). Glucose aldose hai jab ke fructose ketose hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab monosaccharides ki misal mein 'glucose and sucrose' likhti hai. Sucrose monosaccharide nahi, disaccharide hai (kitab khud aage Disaccharides mein yahi batati hai). Sahi misalein: glucose aur fructose.

blocks.alt: Glucose ki open chain (carbon 1 se 6, C1 par aldehyde group) jis mein C5 ke OH ki oxygen ke lone pairs se C1 tak muda hua teer hai, phir teer, aur ring ki shakal: C1 se C5 aur oxygen se bani chhe atoms wali ring, C5 par CH2OH (C6) oopar, aur har ring carbon par H aur OH.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.1: Glucose ki linear (seedhi) aur cyclic (ring wali) structures (kitab ki Figure 27.1 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).
blocks.long_description: Halqe mein C5 ke OH group ki oxygen C1 se jur jati hai; ab C1 par aik OH group (neeche) aur aik H atom hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Muda hua laal teer dikhata hai ke C5 ke OH ki oxygen apne lone pair se C1 ke C=O carbon par hamla karti hai. Is se oxygen C1 aur C5 ke darmiyan pul ban jati hai aur chhe kone wala ring (pyranose) banta hai; C=O ki oxygen ab C1 par OH ban jati hai (laal). Neela O wahi oxygen hai jo pehle C5 ke OH mein thi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Figure 27.1 ke labels mein kitab ne 'glucose open-chain from' aur 'glucose: ring from' chhapa hai. Sahi lafz 'form' (shakal) hai: glucose open-chain form aur glucose ring form.

Monosaccharides do shaklon mein milte hain: open chain (khuli chain) ya ring. Paanch carbon wali sugars (pentoses) aur chhe carbon wali sugars (hexoses) ring ki shakal mein zyada stable (mazboot, aasani se na badalne wali) hoti hain, is liye zyada tar ring ki shakal mein milti hain. Solid (thos) halat mein yeh ring ki shakal mein hoti hain. Maslan fructose paanch kone wala ring banata hai jise furanose kehte hain, aur glucose chhe kone wala ring banata hai jise pyranose kehte hain. Linear (seedhi) chain aur ring wali shakalein aik doosre mein badal sakti hain. Glucose ki linear chain se ring banna (cyclisation) Figure 27.1 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke solution (ghol) mein molecules linear (seedhi chain) ki shakal mein hote hain. Asal mein solution mein bhi zyada tar molecules ring ki shakal mein hote hain, aur open chain wali shakal bohat thori (glucose ke liye 1% se bhi kam) hoti hai; dono shakalein equilibrium (barabar ki halat) mein rehti hain.

Sugar ke molecules mein bohat se hydroxyl groups (–OH) hote hain, is liye un ke molecules ke darmiyan bohat zyada hydrogen bonding hoti hai. Isi wajah se pure (khalis) monosaccharides solid hote hain. Solution mein yeh paani ke molecules se bhi bohat hydrogen bonds banate hain, is liye paani mein bohat zyada soluble (ghulne wale) hain. Monosaccharides jaandaron ke liye instant (fauran milne wali) energy ka behtareen source hain. Glucose ko blood sugar kehte hain kyun ke yeh insani khoon mein hota hai, jab ke fructose phalon aur shehed (honey) mein zyada hota hai.

Shehed mein fructose aur glucose bohat zyada concentration (miqdar) mein hote hain. Shehed ka gaarha pan aur viscosity (gaarha hone ki wajah se aahista behna) inhi ki mazboot hydrogen bonding ki wajah se hai.
2. Disaccharides

Disaccharides do monosaccharide units se bante hain jo glycosidic linkage se jure hote hain; in ka aam formula C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ hai. Sab se aam disaccharides sucrose, lactose aur maltose hain. Yeh condensation reaction (jis mein chhota molecule, yahan paani, nikalta hai) se bante hain: aik monosaccharide ka hydroxyl group doosre monosaccharide ke hydrogen se mil kar paani ka aik molecule bana deta hai, aur dono units covalent bond se jur jate hain. Yeh C–O–C bond glycosidic bond kehlata hai. Maslan sucrose, jo aam table sugar (cheeni) hai, glucose aur fructose ka disaccharide hai (Figure 27.2).

blocks.alt: Glucose (chhe atoms wali ring) aur fructose (paanch atoms wali ring) Haworth rings ki shakal mein; glucose ke C1 ke OH ka H aur fructose ke C2 ka HO dabbe (box) mein hain. Teer sucrose ki taraf jata hai jis mein glucose ka C1 aur fructose ka C2 aik oxygen atom se jure hain, 'glycosidic linkage in sucrose', + H2O.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.2: Sucrose molecule ka banna (kitab ki Figure 27.2 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dabbe mein glucose ke C1 ke OH ka H aur fructose ke C2 ka HO hai; yeh mil kar paani (H₂O) ban kar nikalte hain (condensation). Bachi hui oxygen glucose ke C1 ko fructose ke C2 se jorti hai: yahi C–O–C glycosidic linkage hai.
3. Polysaccharides

Polysaccharides bare molecules hain jo bohat se monosaccharide units ke jurne se bante hain. In ka molecular mass zyada hota hai aur general formula (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ hai. Hydrolysis par yeh saada sugars, yani monosaccharides, dete hain. Aam misalein starch, glycogen, cellulose aur pectin hain. Starch paudon mein energy ka main storage (zakheera) hai aur glucose units se bana hai. Is ke do hisse hain: amylose aur amylopectin.

Amylose ki lambi chains hain jin mein branches (shaakhein) nahi hotin aur bohat se glycosidic linkages hote hain. Amylopectin aik compact (gathi hui) aur highly branched (bohat shaakhon wali) structure hai jo bohat se glucose units se bani hai (Figure 27.3). Kitab ke mutabiq amylopectin paani mein ghulta hai aur amylose nahi ghulta. Aaloo, sugar beet (chukandar), chawal aur anaaj mein bohat starch hota hai.

Cellulose paudon ki cell walls ka main structural material (dhaancha banane wala maadda) hai. Yeh 2500 tak glucose units ki lambi, unbranched (be-shaakh) chains hain jo glycosidic bonds se juri hain (Figure 27.3). Yeh chains aapas mein mazboot hydrogen bonds banati hain, is liye cellulose rigid (sakht) hai aur paani mein nahi ghulta. Paudon ke patte, shaakhein aur tana zyada tar isi se bane hain. Insani khurak mein yeh fibre (resha) ki shakal mein bohat ahem hai aur gut (aanton) ki sehat behtar karta hai. Glycogen, jise animal starch bhi kehte hain, glucose ka polymer hai jo jaanwaron ke liver (jigar) aur muscles mein jama hota hai. Is ki structure amylopectin jaisi hai, lekin is mein branches aur bhi zyada hain; yahi cheez ise starch se alag karti hai. Kitab yeh bhi kehti hai ke glycogen mein amylopectin wali structure nahi hoti.

blocks.alt: a) Amylose: teen glucose rings C1-O-C4 se jure, har link par alpha-link (C1-C4), 1,4 glycosidic linkage. b) Amylopectin: glucose rings ki do rows (qataarein) C1-O-C4 se jureen, aur aik branch (shaakh) jahan oopar wale ring ka C1 O ke zariye neeche wale ring ke CH2 (C6) se jura hai, 1,6 glycosidic linkage. c) Cellulose: teen glucose rings, carbons C likh kar, beta links se O ke zariye jure.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.3: a) Amylose, b) starch mein amylopectin aur c) cellulose ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 27.3 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Amylose aur amylopectin mein glucose ke C1 ki oxygen neeche (alpha) hai aur agle glucose ke C4 se judti hai (1,4 link). Amylopectin mein kuch jagah C1 agle glucose ke C6 (CH₂) se judta hai: yahi 1,6 link shaakh (branch) banata hai. Cellulose mein link beta hai (C1 ki oxygen oopar).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Figure 27.3 mein kitab ne 'a-Link' chhapa hai; sahi 'α-link' (alpha-link) hai. '(1,4 Glyocosidic Inkage)' asal mein '1,4 glycosidic linkage' hai, aur 'Ch₂' asal mein CH₂ hai. Hamari drawing mein sahi likha gaya hai.
Summary (khulasa)

items: Monosaccharides: glucose (aldose), fructose (ketose); solution mein zyada tar ring ki shakal.
Disaccharides (sucrose, lactose, maltose): do units glycosidic link (C–O–C) se, condensation mein paani nikalta hai.
